title: South-East Asia Regional Roadmap for Diagnostic Preparedness, Integrated Laboratory Networking and Genomic Surveillance (2023-2027)
description: WHO regional roadmap for strengthening diagnostic preparedness, integrated laboratory networks, and genomic surveillance across South-East Asia for epidemic and pandemic preparedness.
keyFeatures: Roadmap for diagnostic preparedness and integrated laboratory networking.
Connects genomic surveillance with emergency preparedness and response.
Covers workforce, referral systems, regulatory issues, financing, and sustainability.
Designed for WHO South-East Asia Member States and regional partners.
practicalUse: Use this roadmap to align national laboratory and genomic surveillance plans with regional priorities, identify system-strengthening actions, and guide partner coordination.
